HEALPAT='bash /root/azar_session_heal.[s]h'
# 先停旧的
for p in $(pgrep -f "$HEALPAT"); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null; done
sleep 2
rm -rf /root/.session_heal.lock /root/.session_heal.lock.flock /root/.session_heal.lock.flock.pid /root/.session_heal 2>/dev/null
# 覆盖新脚本
echo "" | base64 -d > /root/azar_session_heal.sh
chmod +x /root/azar_session_heal.sh
echo "[1] md5(期望 e08c7ff6d253dae05edfb223b5eecaa0):"; md5sum /root/azar_session_heal.sh
bash -n /root/azar_session_heal.sh && echo "[2] 语法OK"
# 启动单个
setsid nohup bash /root/azar_session_heal.sh >> /root/session_heal.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
sleep 3
echo "[3] 进程数(期望1):"; pgrep -f "$HEALPAT" | wc -l
pgrep -f "$HEALPAT" | head -3
echo "[4] 启动日志尾:"; tail -3 /root/session_heal.log 2>/dev/null
echo "[5] 登录态:"; bash /root/logincheck.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -E '\[在线\]|\[未登录\]|\[掉线\]' | head -1
echo "=====完====="
